editorial:
Picture a tough hockey player who loves knocking out teeth suddenly forced to wear a tutu and collect kids' teeth under pillows. That is the wild setup you get here, and it is just as silly as it sounds. Derek Thompson is a minor-league hockey star with a bad habit of crushing opponents' teeth, and when he crushes a young fan's belief in magic, he gets sentenced to one week as a real tooth fairy. The movie leans hard into goofy family comedy, with bright costumes, silly gadgets, and a grumpy hero who slowly learns to care. You will see him fumble with wings, shrink down to size, and try to keep his secret from his girlfriend and her kids. The vibe is light, loud, and very kid-friendly, with plenty of slapstick and heart mixed in.

The acting is the real draw, especially the lead, who sells every ridiculous moment with charm and physical comedy. The pacing stays quick, so you never sit too long in one joke, though some gags repeat a bit too often. The story is predictable, but that is part of the comfort. If you want a cozy family night with laughs and a sweet message about believing in yourself, this is a fun pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Derek fully embraces being the tooth fairy and uses his magic to help the kids he cares about. He stops hiding who he is and chooses to be honest with his girlfriend and her children. The big twist is that his punishment was never really about teeth at all, it was about learning to believe in magic and in himself again. He rekindles his old dream of playing in the big leagues, but now with a kinder heart. The movie ends with him happy, still a little goofy, and ready for whatever comes next.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies with slapstick humor and a sweet message.
